usedFor: Groupme runs group chats, and “Create a Message” posts text to a group while “Create group” starts a new one.

bestTemplate.name: “Create a Message” in Groupme
bestTemplate.why: It sends a text message, with optional images or locations, to a selected group.

watchOut: “Destroy a Group” permanently deletes a group found by name, so a partial match could hit the wrong one.
